Biłgoraj Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Biłgoraj, Poland

Demolished. The earliest record of this, the second of Biłgoraj's Jewish cemeteries, dates to 1728, when the kehilla sought land to establish it; it was used until around 1800, when a third cemetery was founded. In 1941, the Germans completely destroyed the site, leveling and plowing the ground, and built three barracks there used as warehouses and stables — the same barracks where Jews were also held before their deportation. A high school playground was later built on the site; a boulder with an inscription now commemorates the cemetery.
